pkgmetadata.longdescription:
The Selenium Server jar is the single binary behind Selenium's "standalone" and "Grid" WebDriver deployment modes. Run with the "standalone" subcommand it exposes one machine's browsers as a WebDriver remote endpoint; run as "hub"/"node" (or the split router/distributor/sessionmap roles) it coordinates WebDriver sessions across multiple machines and browsers.
On arm64, the Selenium Manager helper embedded in the jar (used for automatic browser/driver resolution) is x86-64 only and cannot run. This package depends on dev-util/selenium-manager on arm64 instead, which installs a native arm64 build and an env.d entry exporting SE_MANAGER_PATH, the environment variable Selenium's own SeleniumManager class checks before falling back to its bundled binary. That env.d entry only becomes visible in a refreshed login environment: shells already running at install time do not pick it up automatically, so a new login shell (or manually re-sourcing /etc/profile in an existing one) is needed before SE_MANAGER_PATH is actually set.
